notes.title: Update: New Game Modes and New Spells!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for enjoying Valkyrie of Phantasm!
Today, we have updated to Ver.1.10.

[previewyoutube=IGr0MpK_faw;full][/previewyoutube]

■Game Modes

Added Survival Mode.

■ Story Mode

Added Episodes 1-3 for the final boss.

■ Characters

Reimu:
- Added Dream Sign "Dream Dimensional Rift".
- Recollection "Duplex Barrier": Shortened cooldown time and lowered cost from 400 to 300.
- Spirit Sign "Dream Seal -Spread-": Increased cost from 300 to 350.
Marisa:
- Added Magic Absorber.
- Celestial Apparatus "Orrery's Solar System": Fixed opponent's Drive Gauge recovery amount and lowered cost from 400 to 300.
- Loving Heart "Double Spark": Increased damage from 8,200 to 9,200 and adjusted gauge recovery amount from damage dealt/taken.
- Black Magic "Event Horizon": Increased cost from 300 to 350.
Youmu:
- Added Life-Cutting Sword.
- Added Soul Sign "Wheel of Pain of the Living and Dead".
- Human Sign "Slash of Present World": Increased damage from 7,000 to 9,000 and adjusted gauge recovery amount from damage dealt/taken.
- Reincarnation Sword "Slash of Circular Vicissitude": Increased damage from 12,000 to 14,700 and adjusted gauge recovery amount from damage dealt/taken.
- Hell Fire Sword "Sudden Phantom Formation Slash of Karmic Wind": Lowered homing ability from 15 to 7 and reduced homing detection distance from 50 to 25.
Patchouli:
- Added Water Sign "Jellyfish Princess".
- Water Sign "Princess Undine": Increased cost from 350 to 400, increased time bullets remain on screen from 1.5 to 1.65, lowered homing capability from 15 to 7, and reduced homing detection distance from 60 to 30.
Remilia:
- Added Millennium Vampire.
- Fitful Nightmare: Shortened cooldown time, lowered cost from 400 to 300.
Cirno:
- Added Ice Sign "Fairy Spin".
- Ice Sign "Icicle Fall": Reduced cost from 350 to 300, reduced number of shots from 12 to 10, lowered damage from 9,360 to 7,800, and adjusted gauge recovery amount from damage dealt/taken.
- Frost Sign "Frost Columns": Lowered cost from 350 to 300.
- Ice Sign "Perfect Glacialist": Increased cost from 300 to 350, extended reload time from 3 to 4, and reduced time bullets remain on screen from 2 to 1.65.
- Freeze Sign "Freeze Atmosphere": Lowered cost from 400 to 300.
Meiling:
- Added Chi Sign "Fierce Tiger Energy Release".
- Colorful Flip "Fluttering Petals and Falling Leaves": The ability "Spell Master" now applies to this spell. Lowered cost from 400 to 300.
Clownpiece:
- Added Lunatic Torch Relay.
- Hell Sign "Hell Eclipse": Increased cost from 300 to 350.
- Hellfire "Graze Inferno": Lowered cost from 350 to 300.
- Hellfire "Infernal Essence of Grazing": Lowered cost from 400 to 350.
- Hell Sign "Bursting Grudge": Reduced cost from 350 to 300 and extended reload time from 10 to 15.

■ Character Setup

Added new abilities.
- ★★: Technical Step (Extends invincibility window after a step)
- ★★: Guard Cancel (Allows canceling out of Guard with a step)
- ★★★: Extra Guard (Expands effect range of Guard)
- ★★★: LV2 Drive (Restricts Accel Drive to a maximum of LV2. Wait time in between uses.)
- ★★★: Lock Shift (Allows changing lock-on targets in the middle of a spell, other than Drive Spells)
※These abilities can be unlocked 1 at a time with every 3 stages cleared in Survival Mode.
Added the Spell Set feature, which allows the creation of 4 presets of spells.

■ Network

Added emotes.
Fixed an issue where the Boost Gauge would not fill up/deplete in spectator mode.
Fixed an issue where single match results were added to team results.
Fixed an issue in single matches where accessing the custom settings would softlock the game.

■ Battles

Added a new stage: Misty Lake (3 variations)
Added a new visual indicator for W-Lock.
Changed lock-on order to go through all targets in sequence.
Added draw processing.
Weakened LV1 CPUs.
Fixed an issue where finishing off opponents with a W-Attack would cause the W-Attack icon to remain on the screen.
Fixed an issue where HP still mid-recovery by the end of a match would be counted toward match results.
Fixed an issue where projectiles that do not deal any damage would still cause a warning to be displayed on the UI.
(This applies to Dream Sign "Duplex Barrier" and Water Sign "Jellyfish Princess".)
Hitting 3 charged melee attacks in the same combo will now cause the opponent to do a tailspin.

■Other

Added Steam Achievements.
Adjusted stages.
Fixed typos.


Roadmap
Plans are as of today and are subject to change.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949466/0985fc6ad3be99dec6becb6f4f8ce2989c285c5d.jpg

We hope you continue to enjoy Valkyrie of Phantasm!

notes.title: Valkyrie of Phantasm Full Release Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for enjoying Valkyrie of Phantasm!
Today, we have updated to ver. 1.00, which is the full release and end of Early Access.
After this full release, we will continue to update the game regularly, so please look forward to the further evolution of Valkyrie of Phantasm!

■ Characters

Reimu:
Dream Sign "Duplex Barrier" - Effect duration extended by 5 seconds. Can now also block beam attacks.
Dream Sign "Wild Exorcism Dance" - Shortened time needed to finish firing all bullets.
Marisa:
Celestial Apparatus "Orreries Solar System" - Shortened cooldown, increased damage dealt.
Youmu:
Human Sign "Slash of Present World" - Damage dealt and Drive Gauge recovery amount reduced.
Reincarnation Sword "Slash of Circular Vicissitude" - Damage dealt and Drive Gauge recovery amount increased.
Patchouli:
Sun Wood Sign "Photosynthesis" - Effect duration extended by 5 seconds.
Remilia:
Divine Spear "Spear the Gungnir" - Damage dealt and Drive Gauge recovery amount reduced, cost increased (300→350).
Destiny "Miserable Fate" - Cost reduced (350→300).
Cirno:
Freeze Sign "Freeze Atmosphere" - Now follows behind you more slowly.
Meiling:
Chi Sign "Star-Pulse Shot" - Bullet strength increased.
Clownpiece:
Hell Sign "Bursting Grudge" - Widened horizontal aim range.
Ragnahild:
Adjustments made according to the above.

■ Battles

Added double attacks - Teammate attacks deal more damage, and attacks on a spinning opponent deal 1.2x damage.
Players now recover all bullets when downed in Point Battles.
Lowered the voiceover volume of all characters other than the player (other than specific voicelines).
The Drive Gauge now only starts automatically recovering after the "Ready GO" countdown ends.
Teammate Drive Gauges are now visible.

■ Story Mode

Added Marisa Episode 3, Youmu Episode 3, Patchouli Episode 3, Remilia Episode 3, Cirno Episode 3, Meiling Episode 3, and Clownpiece Episode 3.

■Network

Edited Ragnahild's portrait.
Fixed an issue that caused the character models to load in more slowly than intended during character setup.
Player names will now be displayed above the characters' heads.

■Other

Added achievements.

Roadmap
We have made a new roadmap for post-full release updates.
Plans are as of today and are subject to change.
We plan on adding more Spells and game modes, so please stay tuned for further updates!

notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for enjoying Valkyrie of Phantasm!
Today, we have updated to Ver.EA1.51.

As the network functions are still in an experimental stage, there is a chance that bugs might occur, so we have decided to release the update in beta first.

Note: We recommend you backup your current save data in the following location before opening the beta, just in case.
C:\Users\"Username"\AppData\LocalLow\AreaZero\VOP\

Fixed certain spells that caused incorrect stat changes
Affected spells:
- Cirno: Freeze Sign "Freeze Atmosphere"
- Clownpiece: Hellfire "Infernal Essence of Grazing"

■ Battles

Fixed a bug that caused the clashing sound effect to not be affected by volume settings.
Added a random option to stage select.

■Network

Fixed a bug that prevented matches between 5 or more people.
Fixed the infinite loading bug that occured when connection was lost during the loading screen in online matches.
Made it so that only the room host can open the pause menu.
Added in-game explanations for room match features as well as messages for kicks, disconnects, etc.
Added a process that will automatically log players out of room matches if their computer enters sleep mode.
Miscellaneous UI adjumstments.

We hope you continue to enjoy Valkyrie of Phantasm!

notes.title: Update Ver.EA1.50
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for enjoying Valkyrie of Phantasm!
Today, we have updated to Ver.EA1.50.

As the network functions are still in an experimental stage, there is a chance that bugs might occur, so we have decided to release the update in beta first.
If you wish to join the beta, please go to the game's page in your Steam library and enter the beta password "networktest" to access the network update.
Note: We recommend you backup your current save data in the following location before opening the beta, just in case.
C:\Users\"Username"\AppData\LocalLow\AreaZero\VOP\

■ Characters

Fixed certain spells that caused incorrect stat changes
Affected spells:
- Reimu: Spirit Sign "Dream Seal" 
- Meiling: Colorful Sign "Colorful Light Chaotic Dance", Chi Sign "Earth Dragon Sky Dragon Kick", Colorful Flower "Rainbow Taijiquan"
Fixed Patchouli's knockback time
Added special spells
- Reimu: Dream Sign "Duplex Barrier"
[Effects]
Creates a barrier that nullifies ranged attacks for a limited amount of time. The barrier has durability, and will disappear when its durability is reduced to 0.

- Marisa: Celestial Apparatus "Orreries Solar System"
[Effects]
Creates a magic circle that follows self and automatically shoots star bullets at any approaching opponents.

- Youmu: Spell is taking more time than expected to implement and will be added at a later date.

- Patchouli: Sun Wood Sign "Photosynthesis"
[Effects]
Shines a light above own head. While under the light, boost recovery speed increases. The light follows self slowly, and will lag behind during fast movement.

- Remilia: Fitful Nightmare
[Effects]
Shoots bullets in all directions.

- Cirno: Freeze Sign "Freeze Atmosphere"
[Effects]
Creates ice objects that follow self slowly and reduce the boost recovery speed of any opponents within range.

- Meiling: Colorful Flip "Fluttering Petals and Falling Leaves"
[Effects]
Rise high into the air, spin once, and perform a hammer kick.

- Clownpiece: Hellfire "Infernal Essence of Grazing"
[Effects]
Raises own gauge recovery rate of grazes for a limited amount of time.

■ Stages

Added Skies of Gensokyo (Noon, Evening, Dawn)

■ Battles

Added CPU level settings (Character Select -> Side Menu -> Options)
Reduced Drive stun range (experimental change)
Reduced boost gauge cost of front step (experimental change)
Reduced boost gauge recovery rate of grazes (experimental change)
Adjusted Drive Gauge recovery rate of each spell (experimental change)
[High recovery rate] Long-range spells > Mid-range spells > Close-range spells [Low recovery rate]

■Training Mode

Changed the layout of the damage amount display
A limit warning will now display after landing consecutive melee attacks of the same type.

■Network

Added team battles and overhauled the network UI

■Other

Overall UI adjustments and added instructions for controls

■Supplementary Notes

Spell descriptions and spell effect indicator UI will be added during the full release.
Experimental changes may or may not be implemented during the full release depending on the climate of online matches.
Unimplemented spells (additional special spells and Ultimates) will be added after the full release depending on the climate of online matches.
We will continue to observe and tweak features for more balanced combat and better network synchronization.

We hope you continue to enjoy Valkyrie of Phantasm!

[previewyoutube=2-D71rSsjwo;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi everyone,

Thank you for enjoying Valkyrie of Phantasm!

We're excited to announce that Reimu Hakurei will be voiced by Kana Ichinose in Valkyrie of Phantasm!
She will also be the voice of Volvarior, the Valkyrie Arms equipped by Reimu.
When the voiceover is added for the full release, please enjoy not only the conversations between Reimu and Volvarior, but also Kana Ichinose's superb acting for both of them!
We're planning on gradually revealing the voice actresses for the other characters in the days leading up to the full release in the summer, so please follow Area-ZERO on X (formerly Twitter) to stay up to date!

Official Area-ZERO X (formerly Twitter): https://x.com/zukky_areazero

We hope you continue to enjoy Valkyrie of Phantasm!

notes.title: Update Ver.EA1.01
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for enjoying Valkyrie Of Phantasm!
Today, we have updated to Ver.EA1.01.

■General

 UI adjustments


■Story

 Lowered the CPU level of the 1st and 2nd battles.


■Tutorial

 Added "Next" and "Return to Select Menu" options after each input tutorial.


■Training Mode

 Implemented a simple Training Mode. (More in-depth settings will be added on a later date)


■Battle System

 Fixed an issue where spells in which you rush towards the opponent would let the player character go out-of-bounds.
 A barrier will be displayed when characters are close to the edges of the stage. (This is a temporary patch)


■Characters

 Common: Fixed animations for melee attacks and spells. (No changes were made to hitboxes)
 Patchouli: Fixed an issue which caused Patchouli to be immobile for a longer time than other characters when launched into the air.


Note: We will continue to observe and tweak features for more balanced combat.

 Regarding the issue where controllers don't work:
We are working towards a proper fix for this issue, but as a temporary measure, please try the following:
Unplug all controllers from the PC
Go to the C:\Users\UserName\AppData\LocalLow\AreaZero\VOP\Save folder
Delete the Key.dat file
This can potentially fix the problem when you next launch the game. [

notes.title: Update 1.00ｂ
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for enjoying Valkyrie Of Phantasm!
Today, we have updated to ver 1.00b.

■Network

 The opponent's name will now be displayed during battle.      
  

■Battle System

 Spells and melee attacks can no longer be canceled with shots.
 Activating Accel Drive will now fully replenish the Boost Gauge.
 The stun caused by the opponent activating Accel Drive can now be guarded.
 Accel Drive can no longer be activated while guarding.
 Reduced the passive regeneration rate of the Drive Gauge.        
 Dealing and receiving damage now fills the Drive Gauge.
 The animation shown when taking damage while in Accel Drive will no longer be influenced by the increased movement speed.    
    

■Abilities

 "Crisis" Series: Fixed known issues found in the "Crisis" series of abilities.       
 Assault Spirits: Fixed issue where the ability had no effect       
 Magic Influence: Fixed issue where the ability had no effect        


■Characters:

 General: Lowered the knockdown values of melee attacks (neutral, front, back, and sides)
 Shot: Shots are now more effective at chipping away Guard, but no longer count towards Graze.   


Reimu       

 Spirit Sign "Dream Seal -Concentrate-": Reduced effect duration
 Dream Sign "Evil-Sealing Circle": Canceling after this spell will now consume a fixed amount of Boost Gauge     
 Dream Sign "Wild Exorcism Dance": Added flinch effect. Improved close-range homing. Reduced knockdown value. Reduced Accel Gauge recovery gained from Grazing this spell.


Marisa

 Love Sign "Master Spark": Canceling after this spell will now consume a fixed amount of Boost Gauge. Reduced reloading time.      
 Loving Heart "Double Spark": Canceling after this spell will now consume a fixed amount of Boost Gauge. Reduced reloading time.    
 Comet "Blazing Star": Reduced knockdown value.


Youmu

 Human Sign "Slash of Present World": Canceling after this spell will now consume a fixed amount of Boost Gauge.        
 Reincarnation Sword "Slash of Circular Vicissitude": Canceling after this spell will now consume a fixed amount of Boost Gauge.       
 Spirit-Cutting Sword "Slash of Ascension to Buddhahood": Improved cross-up hit box in close range, Reduced knockdown value.


Patchouli

 Earth Metal Sign "Emerald Megalith": Canceling after this spell will now consume a fixed amount of Boost Gauge.        
 Moon Sign "Silent Selene": Reduced knockdown value.


Note: We will continue to adjust features surrounding the Drive Gauge and Graze mechanics.

notes.title: Valkyrie of Phantasm Coming Soon to Steam’s Early Access
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are proud to announce Valkyrie of Phantasm’s imminent introduction to Steam’s Early Access on 23rd October, 2022. 

Soar through the skies freely, dodge a rain of enemy fire gracefully, and counter with a variety of dazzling spells in Valkyrie of Phantasm, Area-ZERO’s (Touhou Sky Arena) latest Touhou Derivative Project that’s faster and more thrilling than anything before.

Control characters from the Touhou Project series in this shooting action game featuring high-speed aerial versus combat! Bullet hell battles faster than you've ever seen will unfold in the skies of Gensokyo as you use your mobility to dodge countless bullets flying at you with a variety of spells.

[previewyoutube=49BL-OsMF6o;full][/previewyoutube]

We've also got a playable demo at our TGS booth, so come try it out for yourselves.
You can find us at Hall 1 Booth 1-C03.
We hope to see you there!
